mentions.name: Novel browser game
mentions.description: This is an unnamed browser game with a game mechanic the author describes as novel, built on novel infrastructure. It was developed over 5-6 years as the author's tenth and final attempt and is planned to launch on Hacker News soon.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Possibly the most insane browser game of all time? Big if true.

I will launch on hackernews soon-ish.

But the game mechanic itself is novel, and the infrastructure is novel.
